# Cheflink

> Cheflink is a QR ordering and table management system for restaurants and bars. Guests scan a QR code at their table to browse the menu and place orders directly from their phone — no app or account required. Staff see every order and table tab in real time through a single dashboard.

- [Home (English)](https://cheflink.io/en/): Product overview, features, pricing, and FAQ
- [Home (Spanish)](https://cheflink.io/es/): Versión en español — características, precios y preguntas frecuentes

## Product summary

Cheflink covers the full dining flow:

1. Each table has a unique QR code. Guests scan it and the menu opens in their browser — no download, no sign-up.
2. Orders arrive instantly in the Cheflink dashboard. Kitchen staff and servers see every ticket in real time.
3. Orders are grouped into table tabs. Staff can apply discounts, service charges, and mark tabs as paid in one click.

**Key features:** QR menu and ordering, Kitchen Display System (KDS), table tabs, multi-location support, real-time updates, localized currency and tax configuration.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Best for |
|------|-------|----------|
| Starter | $0/month | Trying out Cheflink (1 venue, 1 table, 5 orders/day) |
| Premium | $99/month | Small and medium restaurants (1 venue, unlimited tables and orders) |
| Diamond | Custom | Large operations (unlimited venues, digital payments, loyalty programs) |
